NHRC Chief's remarks on 'tests' at event attended by CJI

At an event attended by Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant, National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) Chairman Arun Mishra made remarks about "tests" that individuals face. Punjab Kesari reported Mishra stating that the CJI has to go through an "ag Pariksha" (trial by fire) every minute. News18 Hindi quoted Mishra as saying, "Not everyone who gives a test is always right," in the presence of CJI Surya Kant.
